hints.title: Column-by-Column Reachability
hints.text: Every move advances strictly from column c to column c + 1 to a strictly greater value.

hints.title: Maintain Reachable Rows
hints.text: Maintain the set of reachable row indices at column c, beginning with all rows at column 0.

hints.title: Transition Condition
hints.text: Row nr in column c + 1 is reachable if nr is in {r - 1, r, r + 1} for some reachable r and grid[nr][c + 1] > grid[r][c].

hints.title: Column Reachability Simulation Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Exhaustive branching without memoization revisits overlapping states exponentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) memory for reachable row sets.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes column-wise topological ordering and maintains reachability set.
